rejected.reason: The source mechanism relies on dry van der Waals forces amplified by hierarchical nanoscale contact, which are fundamentally screened by water molecules at underwater interfaces. The target environment (seawater at 50m depth) introduces a continuous water layer that prevents the nanoscale conformal contact required for intermolecular force summation. The source's failure conditions explicitly include 'excessive environmental humidity screening forces' — underwater conditions represent the extreme of this failure mode. The target also requires chemical curing for 20-year durability, while the source mechanism is non-chemical and reversible. No plausible translation preserves the causal structure (hierarchical branching → intermolecular force amplification → reversible dry adhesion) in a permanently wet, high-pressure, saline environment requiring irreversible structural bonding.
